input.quote: 2.2 Vendor will be Customer's sole and exclusive provider of hosted analytics services throughout the term.
input.rationale: The first Section 2.2 (p0013) binds Customer to Vendor as its sole and exclusive provider of hosted analytics services for the whole term, with no category limitation beyond that, no 12-month cap, and no automatic exit for service-level or delivery failures. That is walk-away territory (exclusive dealing for the full term with no performance-based exit) and fails every fallback element. It also directly contradicts Section 12.3, where Vendor acknowledges Customer has made no exclusivity commitment, and Section 2.1's no-purchase-commitment language. We therefore take the preferred position and make Vendor non-exclusive with the shortest edit, which also cures the internal conflict.

mappings.element: Customer has no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation.

proposal.summary: Make Vendor a non-exclusive provider in the first Section 2.2
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We changed the first Section 2.2 so that Vendor is a non-exclusive provider, since our playbook does not accept any exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation on Customer; this also removes the conflict with Sections 2.1 and 12.3, which confirm no purchase or exclusivity commitment.
